summary: This bill amends the Fair Labor Standards Act of 1938 to allow 16- and 17-year-olds to be employed in certain hazardous timber harvesting occupations if they work for a parent or guardian.

scores.thoughts: This bill amends the Fair Labor Standards Act to exempt 16- and 17-year-olds employed in certain timber harvesting operations from child labor laws, particularly when employed by a parent. This directly impacts labor regulations by loosening child labor protections in a specific industry, which generally aligns with employer flexibility rather than increased labor laws.
